name: Logica Infoway Limited
summary: Established in 1995 and headquartered in Kolkata, India, Logica Infoway Limited operates as a distributor and retailer of information technology products and associated services throughout India. The company's comprehensive offering spans various IT hardware and software, including smartphones, laptops, desktop computers, monitors, printers, storage devices, and a range of accessories such as laptop bags, wireless products, and general peripherals. Furthermore, they provide specialized networking and security solutions. Logica Infoway reaches its diverse customer base via an extensive network comprising physical retail stores, distribution hubs, channel partnerships, virtual offices, and e-commerce platforms. The company underwent a name change in January 2024, transitioning from Eastern Logica Infoway Limited to its current designation.
